strategic_horizon.terminal_goal: Build a personal weak-network VPN for OpenWrt/Linux/Windows with a TCP-shaped WBD raw/FakeTCP carrier, datagram-like no-HOL inner delivery, real DTLS 1.3, optional fixed WBD FEC, optional browser-like TLS Persona, concurrent multi-device sessions per account, and client-selectable global/China/non-China capture.
strategic_horizon.current_milestone: V2-M8B-T2: fixed-FEC scheduler qualification plus immutable per-association LINK_INIT/LINK_ACCEPT setup. All link-defining parameters are chosen once before Established; changing them requires a fresh association. Auto FEC remains future advanced research.
strategic_horizon.local_optimization_stop_rule: Do not delay an available systematic source to fill a FEC block. Do not replace the live qualified RS path from iid-only simulator evidence. Do not add a runtime link-parameter control plane. Inner first-complete transport performance remains the first optimization priority, even when retransmission/FEC buffers consume additional memory.

product_policy.link_setup: client proposes all current link-defining data parameters once in LINK_INIT; server accepts the exact config or rejects it; after LINK_ACCEPT/AUTH/Established parameters are immutable and any change requires a fresh association; there is no runtime config epoch
product_policy.fec: client/session selects off or a live-admitted fixed profile at establishment; live admission currently off or 20:20 tail-RS; Auto is reserved future advanced research and rejected now
product_policy.accounts: same username/account may own multiple simultaneous device sessions; live state keyed by account plus unique session id; prefer per-device high-entropy credentials and independent revocation
product_policy.routing: client capture modes off|global|only-cn|only-non-cn; mandatory underlay endpoint escape; Linux/OpenWrt use policy routing/prefix sets; Windows uses Wintun-class L3 plus broad routes or compact WFP/equivalent split classifier, never thousands of persistent firewall rules
product_policy.persona: ClientHello browser profile is client-selected from the server-supported set; Persona is separate real TLS 1.3 preflight. Endpoint hostname/certificate/private key must be identities the operator is authorized to use; public third-party sites may be measurement baselines but are not borrowed WBD identities.
product_policy.dual_lane: deferred until a one-lane fixed-protection cliff is measured; prefer striped/hedged independent repair with lane-specific equations/seeds/timing rather than byte-identical duplication; any >2x survival mode requires separate admission
